title: Light Brazilian Fish Fillet Bowl
description: Sweet, crisp, light Brazilian dish featuring fish fillet, perfect for a quick and healthy meal. This recipe is sugar-free friendly and uses a lazy susan spinner to make serving easy.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the cod fillets on the baking sheet.
Drizzle olive oil over the cod fillets and season with salt and black pepper.
Bake the cod fillets for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
While the cod is baking, heat a skillet over medium heat and add saut3e onions and garlic.
Once the onions are translucent, add the Brazilian-style farofa and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the fresh tomatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
To assemble the dish, place a cod fillet on each serving plate.
Top the cod with a spoonful of the farofa mixture and garnish with fresh cilantro leaves.
Garnish with additional fresh cilantro leaves if desired.
Use a lazy susan spinner to easily serve the dish.
